newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold exchange prices down, volume steady.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold exchange prices down, volume steady.

text.p: Trade remained quiet on the Istanbul gold exchange on Wednesday and prices fell in line with lower world levels, with traders expecting further drops in international gold markets, dealers said.
Volume was steady at 740 kilos compared to 737 kilos on Tuesday as prices eased to $374.20 an ounce from $375.10, and to 1,217,500 lira per gram from 1,218,900.

"Traders expect the ounce (price) to fall further and there is not much trade in the market. Free market traders try to switch gold positions to cash currencies ahead of the year-end," one dealer said.

There was 635 kilos of trade in the morning session and only 105 kilos in the afternoo. Just over half of all trade, 50.7 percent of the total, was in dollar terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
